info.title: Tahir's List API
info.description: HTTP API for Tahir's List. Contract lives at openapi/v1.json (OpenAPI 3.1). Authenticated operations take an RS256 access JWT in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Error bodies use the `{code,message}` ErrorResponse envelope unless an operation says otherwise.

post.description: Denies the certification review, recording the reason; the listing stays unverified. Requires the Verification Committee role.

requestBody.description: Optional: an absent or empty body is treated as `{}`, but a denial still requires a non-blank `reason`.

400.description: A denial reason is required, the body is unreadable, or `reviewId` is not a UUID (`invalid_input`)

post.description: Approves the certification review and promotes the listing to VERIFIED (the only path to a verified listing). Requires the Verification Committee role.

requestBody.description: Optional decision facts; an absent or empty body means "no reason / no certifier / no expiry".

400.description: Unreadable body, malformed `expiresOn`, or `reviewId` is not a UUID (`invalid_input`)

get.description: Minimal unfiltered browse surface (sc-157). Each card exposes only a thumbnail-size hero; filtered location search is served by /v1/listings/search. Public.

post.description: Creates a new, always-unverified restaurant listing owned by the authenticated account. Does not geocode; the client supplies coordinates.

400.description: Field validation failed or the body is unreadable (`invalid_input`)

get.description: Full listing detail including the full-res hero image URL and, for a VERIFIED listing whose certification was approved, the certificate display facts (certifier / reviewedOn / expiresOn / certificateUrl) so the detail trust panel can render non-empty fields (sc-73 follow-up). Public.

patch.description: Full replace of the listing's editable content fields by its owner (sc-23/47/48); identity and governance fields (id, ownerId, verificationStatus, createdAt) are preserved. An omitted nullable boolean clears it to null. Structured-address fields are intentionally not editable here.

400.description: Field validation failed, the body is unreadable, or `id` is not a UUID (`invalid_input`)

403.description: Authenticated account is not the listing owner (`not_listing_owner`)

get.description: Same-origin proxy returning only the requested variant's bytes (thumbnail_400/768/1280/1920 or full original). Public; responses are cacheable for a day.

Content-Disposition.description: `inline` for an allowlisted image type; `attachment` for any other stored type.

400.description: Missing or unknown `variant`, or `id` is not a UUID (`invalid_input`)

404.description: No stored image for this variant (`not_found`)

put.summary: Upload or replace the listing hero image
put.description: Owner-only last-write-wins replace of the listing's single hero image (sc-53). The stored media type is derived from the bytes, never from the part header; every thumbnail width is regenerated. An undecodable image is a 400 and stores nothing.

400.description: Missing `image` part, undecodable image, malformed multipart body, or `id` is not a UUID (`invalid_input`)

403.description: Authenticated account is not the listing owner (`not_listing_owner`)

413.description: Single file exceeds 8 MiB, too many multipart parts, or a form field exceeds 8 KiB (`payload_too_large`)

delete.description: Owner-only removal of every stored variant of the listing's hero image (sc-54). Idempotent: removing an image the listing never had is still a 204.

204.description: Image removed (or already absent); no body

403.description: Authenticated account is not the listing owner (`not_listing_owner`)

get.description: Same-origin proxy returning the archived certification image bytes that the committee approved (the CertificatePanel's View certificate target). Only approved evidence is addressable: the listing must be VERIFIED, its latest APPROVED review must reference an archived artifact, and that object must still exist; otherwise the response is 404. Public and cacheable for a day. Stored evidence whose type is not an allowlisted image is served as an opaque attachment.

Content-Disposition.description: `inline` for an allowlisted image type; `attachment` for legacy/undecodable evidence.

application/octet-stream.description: Legacy/undecodable stored evidence is served as an opaque attachment, never rendered inline.

404.description: No serveable certificate evidence: the listing is not VERIFIED, has no approved review, or the approved artifact is missing (`not_found`)

post.description: Submits ownership proof + a certification image for the listing; drives the listing through the verification state machine (SUBMITTED -> AI_REVIEW -> AI_SUGGESTED) and returns the created review. Explicit AI-analysis consent is required (`aiConsent` must be the string `true`). Owner-only.

aiConsent.description: Explicit consent to AI analysis of the certification image: the string `true` (case-insensitive) or `false`.

201.description: Review created and driven to AI_SUGGESTED

400.description: Missing proof / consent / certification image, blank proof, consent not given, malformed multipart body, or `listingId` is not a UUID (`invalid_input`)

403.description: Authenticated account is not the listing owner (`not_listing_owner`)

413.description: Certification image exceeds 8 MiB, too many multipart parts, or a form field exceeds 8 KiB (`payload_too_large`)

503.description: Verification provider unavailable; the review is held in AI_REVIEW for retry (`verification_unavailable`)

get.description: Returns listings within `radius` (miles) of `center` (latitude,longitude), ordered by straight-line distance ascending. `handCutOnly` (true/false; absent = any) is an extra on/off filter that narrows to hand-cut listings only; `deliveryOnly` (true/false; absent = any) narrows to listings offering delivery (sc-184); `cuisine` (repeatable) with `cuisineLogic` AND or OR (default OR) narrows by multi-cuisine membership; `minPrice`/`maxPrice` bound the price range; `minRating` sets the minimum listing rating on the 0..5 scale. Only no-cross-contamination listings are in the index. (sc-10 location, sc-42 hand-cut, sc-184 delivery, sc-43 price, sc-44 cuisine, sc-45 rating). Public — the core search UX.

parameters.name: center
parameters.description: `<lat>,<lng>` of the search centre. Snapped to the configured 3 or 4 decimal places (4 by default, about 11 m) before the query, so fixes that round to the same grid point return the same result; `distanceMiles` and radius membership are computed from the snapped centre. Configured by `APP_SEARCH_CENTRE_DECIMALS`.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles; must be positive.

parameters.name: handCutOnly
parameters.description: `true` narrows to hand-cut listings; absent/`false` means any cutting status.

parameters.name: deliveryOnly
parameters.description: `true` narrows to delivery listings; absent/`false` means any.

parameters.name: cuisine
parameters.description: Repeatable; values are trimmed, lowercased and de-duplicated.

parameters.name: minRating
parameters.description: Minimum rating on the closed 0..5 scale.

Cache-Control.description: Freshness window for the public result. `public, max-age=60, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=60` by default; configured by `APP_SEARCH_CACHE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS`, `APP_SEARCH_CACHE_S_MAXAGE_SECONDS` and `APP_SEARCH_CACHE_SWR_SECONDS`. Every non-200 response keeps `no-store`.

400.description: Missing/malformed `center` or `radius`, or a malformed `handCutOnly`, `deliveryOnly`, `cuisine`, `cuisineLogic`, price, rating, offset or limit value (`invalid_input`)

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's favourited listings as browse-card objects identical to the /v1/listings read shape.

post.description: Records the authenticated user's favourite for a listing. Idempotent — favouriting the same listing twice is a no-op.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated user's favourite for a listing. Idempotent — unfavouriting a listing that is not favourited (or does not exist) is a no-op, so there is no 404.

post.description: Validates the email/password, hashes the password with Argon2id, persists the account with the default role, and returns the created account. Public but rate limited.

Rotates the refresh token presented in the HttpOnly cookie: revokes it and issues a fresh access token in the body plus a new refresh cookie. No request body; the token travels only in the cookie. Public but rate limited.

200.description: Rotated; new access token + refresh cookie issued

Set-Cookie.description: Rotated refresh token as an opaque 256-bit base64url value (not a JWT): `refresh_token=<opaque>; Path=/v1/auth; Max-Age=2592000; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` (plus `Secure` unless explicitly disabled for plain-HTTP development).

401.description: Invalid, expired, or already-used refresh token (`invalid_credentials`); the dead cookie is cleared

post.description: Revokes the refresh token presented in the HttpOnly cookie so it can no longer be used to obtain a fresh access token, and clears the cookie. Idempotent: always succeeds regardless of whether the token was ever valid.

Verifies the email/password against the stored Argon2id hash and returns a short-lived access token (RS256 JWT with the account's RBAC role) in the body; the rotating refresh token is set as an HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax cookie scoped to the auth routes and is never returned in JSON. Public but rate limited.

Set-Cookie.description: The refresh token: `refresh_token=<jwt>; Path=/v1/auth; Max-Age=2592000; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` (plus `Secure` when enabled).

400.description: Invalid email/password input or unreadable body (`invalid_input`)

401.description: Invalid email or password (generic, no user enumeration) (`invalid_credentials`)

get.description: Verification Committee workqueue: every certification review awaiting a human decision (AI_SUGGESTED). Requires the Verification Committee role.

get.summary: May the caller change this listing's photo?
get.description: Answers the same question as `PUT /v1/listings/{id}/image`: the recorded owner or an account whose verified JWT carries `role: ADMIN`. Returns only a boolean — never the owner's id — so the public detail payload stays viewer-neutral. SC-205.

200.description: Whether the caller may manage the listing's photo

get.description: Returns the identity carried by the verified access JWT (account id as `sub`, plus the RBAC `role` claim).

403.description: No verified principal was attached to the call (`forbidden`)

get.description: Public liveness payload; the exact JSON body is part of the orchestration contract.

bearerAuth.description: RS256 access JWT minted by `/v1/auth/login` or `/v1/auth/refresh`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

ErrorResponse.description: The uniform error envelope. `message` is always serialized (explicit nulls are part of the JSON contract).

DecideRequest.description: The approve/deny body; every field is optional. A denial requires a non-blank `reason`.

expiresOn.description: ISO-8601 date (`yyyy-MM-dd`) transcribed from the certificate at approval.

ReviewResponse.description: The Verification Committee's view of a certification review.

state.description: Review lifecycle state (SUBMITTED, AI_REVIEW, AI_SUGGESTED, HUMAN_REVIEW, APPROVED, DENIED, REVERSED).

CreateListingRequest.description: Add Listing request (sc-138): the shape the add-listing form submits. Coordinates are supplied directly; this path does not geocode.

isHandCut.description: Tri-state: true = hand-cut, false = not hand-cut, null = unknown.

isDelivery.description: Tri-state: true = offers delivery, false = does not, null = unknown.

UpdateListingRequest.description: Edit Listing request (sc-23/47/48): a FULL replace of the editable content fields, same shape as create minus the structured-address fields the edit path intentionally preserves.

isHandCut.description: Tri-state: an omitted/null value clears it to null (unknown).

isDelivery.description: Tri-state: an omitted/null value clears it to null (unknown).

HalalItem.description: One halal menu item as carried on the wire (`{name, isHalal}`).

ListingResponse.description: The create/patch response: the persisted listing identity + governance facts.

ClaimResponse.description: The review created by an owner claim (sc-46).

state.description: Review lifecycle state; a successful claim lands in AI_SUGGESTED.

AuthResponse.description: The access-token half of the session; the refresh token travels only in the HttpOnly cookie.

role.description: RBAC role claim (USER, RESTAURANT_OWNER, VERIFIED_RESTAURANT_OWNER, VERIFICATION_COMMITTEE, ISSUES_COMMITTEE, EXTENSION_TRIGGER).

BrowseCard.description: Minimal browse/search card; carries a thumbnail only ("no oversized fetch on cards").

SrcsetEntry.description: One responsive image candidate: `url` serves an image `width` pixels wide.

Certificate.description: CertificatePanel display facts sourced from the latest APPROVED review.

reviewedOn.description: ISO-8601 instant the committee approved the certification.

expiresOn.description: ISO-8601 date the certification expires; null when unknown.

certificateUrl.description: Same-origin URL serving the archived certification image.

DetailResponse.description: Full listing detail, including the full-res hero and certificate facts.

certificate.description: Null for an unverified listing or one whose certificate was never approved.

SearchCard.description: A browse card plus the search-only facts (rating, straight-line distance).

rating.description: Listing rating on the 0..5 scale; null when unrated.

distanceMiles.description: Straight-line miles from the snapped search centre; within about 0.005 mi of the distance from the requested centre.

MeResponse.description: The identity carried by the verified access JWT.

ManageResponse.description: Whether the calling account may add or replace this listing's hero photo (SC-205).
